name: bathroom-emergency-guide
description: A sourced, printable decision guide for bathroom-sized emergencies.

scripts.build:guide: npm run build:diagrams && npm run build:inventories && ./bin/build_guide.sh all
scripts.build:a4half: npm run build:diagrams && npm run build:inventories && ./bin/build_guide.sh a4half
scripts.test: python3 bin/validate_routes.py && python3 bin/validate_continuity.py && python3 bin/validate_reference_index.py && python3 bin/validate_coverage_matrix.py && python3 bin/validate_subguides.py && python3 bin/validate_render_tooling.py && python3 bin/validate_visualizations.py && python3 bin/validate_illustrations.py && python3 bin/validate_migration.py && python3 bin/validate_guide.py && python3 bin/verify_layout.py --quiet && python3 bin/verify_density.py && python3 bin/verify_accessibility.py && node bin/verify_overflow.mjs && python3 bin/validate_site.py && node bin/verify_site.mjs && python3 bin/validate_build_matrix.py
scripts.build:largeprint: npm run build:diagrams && npm run build:inventories && ./bin/build_guide.sh largeprint
scripts.build:inventories: python3 bin/build_inventories.py && python3 bin/build_source_inventory.py && python3 bin/build_reference_index.py && python3 bin/build_coverage_matrix.py
